Relevant private code goes to Nebius. Test isolation does not mean reasoning stays on the company's laptop.

captions: Lightning investigated the public case; Nano investigated the private pilot. Super proposed and independently reviewed both candidates.
Ultra was separately checked, not proven better. Future routing should follow evaluations of correctness, latency, and cost.

name: Real provider usage, with limits
title: Four tiers appear in recorded usage.
detail: Usage confirms requests. It does not establish accuracy, value or per-change economics.
label: User-supplied usage view · Rounded buckets · Not an exact per-change invoice
captions: The supplied Nebius usage view records four model tiers. It confirms usage, not correctness.
Rounded cost buckets cannot establish cost per accepted fix. That requires reconciled usage across successful and rejected attempts.

name: What the AI harness controls
title: The model reasons. Trusted code authorizes.
detail: Each transition has an explicit input, output and check.
label: Implemented architecture diagram · No unrestricted agent execution
captions: The harness bounds evidence, requires structured output, and validates changes. The model has no shell, network, or publishing tool.
Trusted server code controls testing and publication. The model proposes; the application authorizes each transition.

Current execution is a pure JavaScript diagnostic-parser change. Broader languages and dependencies need additional test profiles and evaluations.

name: Bind the fix to exact inputs
title:

captions: The candidate is bound to its base commit, patch hash, and evidence revision. Proof and approval refer to those inputs.
Changed code or evidence invalidates old approval. Passing proof cannot authorize a different candidate.

name: Reproduce, then verify the same tests
title:
First, it fails.
Then, the same
tests pass.
detail:
Original: 1 failed, 3 passed.
Candidate: 4 passed, 0 failed.
The tests stayed unchanged.
label: Actual test result · Network-disabled execution container
captions: GitHub Actions executes both versions in a network-disabled container. The original has one failure and three passes.
The candidate passes all four unchanged test cases. That proves covered behavior, not every input or hardware condition.

The private pilot rejected self-approval. The QA accounts are synthetic; this demonstrates a permission boundary, not customer adoption.
